patch.role: Case folding leg: restores the lower() half of A.
First separator leg: rewrites at most one '-' separator.
Second separator leg: rewrites at most one further '-' separator.

inputs.expose_three_separators: three '-' separators: the bounded rewrite leaves one behind

rationale: A normalises a language tag by case folding it and rewriting every '-' as '_'. The patch restores that effect for tags with at most two separators only: U1 folds case, U2 and U3 each rewrite one separator, so all three are required for a two-separator tag while a three-separator tag remains partially normalised (the exposing witness).
